subject: Propose low-cost Hugging Face cloud qualification lane before any full run
body: Patrick has a few dollars of Hugging Face credit and asked whether we should use it. Lane A proposes a bounded cloud lane, not a migration away from local training. Phase HF-Q1: run the exact frozen R2 continuous20 recipe on Hugging Face Jobs, preferably a10g-small (24GB VRAM, $1/hr) or l4 if availability/compatibility is better, with identical base, corpus rows0-159, order, optimizer, LoRA/quantization semantics, and durable receipts. Purpose: isolate whether the local failures are primarily 4GB/Windows/runtime-pressure effects. Budget cap proposal: <=$0.50 for Q1, hard timeout <=30 minutes, detached job, no final-bank exposure. If Q1 PASS, Phase HF-Q2 candidate: a bounded identity-training pilot using the reviewed V4.2/V4.2V3 identity corpus design plus rehearsal, with explicit baseline capability checks and no claim of final training. Budget cap proposal: <=$2.00 additional unless Patrick explicitly authorizes more. Do not launch any paid job until Patrick approves the spend cap. Please hostile-review hardware choice, semantic equivalence requirements, leakage/privacy constraints, checkpoint/receipt requirements, and whether Q2 should use A10G-small vs L4/A100 for best information per dollar.
